name: Sora
description: Text-to-video model creating realistic scenes from written prompts.
longDescription: Sora is OpenAI's video generation model capable of creating realistic and imaginative scenes from text instructions. It can generate videos up to one minute long while maintaining visual quality and adherence to the user's prompt.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import openai

client = openai.OpenAI()
response = client.videos.generate(
    model="sora",
    prompt="A cat playing piano in a jazz bar"
)
print(response.data[0].url)

codeSnippets.label: JavaScript
cURL
codeSnippets.code:
curl https://api.openai.com/v1/video/generations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"sora","prompt":"A cat playing piano in a jazz bar"}'
